newsitem.title: GEORGIA: Georgia to tender copper/barium mining complex.
newsitem.headline: Georgia to tender copper/barium mining complex.

text.p: Ex-Soviet Georgia has announced a tender to operate the state-owned Madneuli mining complex, an official of the State Property Ministry said on Wednesday.
Madneuli contains the country's largest reserves of copper and barium, as well as some gold.
Deputy Minister David Gelashvili said the tender would be fully open to foreign companies and investors, and bids must be at least $10 million.

He said the winner of the tender would get exclusive rights to buy and sell Madneuli's output for five years through an operating company to be set up for this purpose. The investor would hold 51 percent of the operating company's shares.
Bids to the Property Ministry were open until August 1 and the results of the tender would be announced in September.
The ministry has estimated Madneuli's value at $16 million.
